_meta.purpose: Canonical record of which model artifacts we are using.
_meta.rule: Binary files in this directory are gitignored. This registry is committed. To prove which file produced a number, look up the sha256 here.

dynaguide_model.pth.description: Trained dynamics model (FinalStatePredictionDino). Predicts future DinoV2 latents from (obs, action_chunk). The '_5900' suffix in the original filename indicates training epoch.
structural_checks_passed: contains proprio_embedder.* keys (Linear projection for 15-d proprio)
contains reconstruction_model.* keys (VQVAE decoder for visualization)

base_policy.pth.description: Robomimic diffusion policy checkpoint trained on CALVIN-D. algo_name='diffusion_policy', contains model.nets + model.ema + config + normalization stats. The '_300' suffix in the original filename indicates training epoch.
structural_checks_passed: top-level keys include: model, config, algo_name, env_metadata, shape_metadata, action_normalization_stats
model has both 'nets' and 'ema' sub-keys (EMA enabled, matches paper §B.1)

switch_on_guidance.hdf5.description: Guidance conditions g+ for switch_on. 20 demonstration trajectories where the robot flipped the switch on. Each demo has obs (eye_in_hand, proprio, states, third_person), actions, dones, rewards. The '_20' suffix matches the paper's |g+|=20 default.
structural_checks_passed: each demo has obs/{eye_in_hand, proprio, states, third_person}, actions, dones, rewards
demo_0 third_person shape: (46, 200, 200, 3) — RGB images at 200x200
demo_0 actions shape: (46, 7) — 7-d action space matches paper
